description: This file contains Redux action creators and async functions for searching posts and files, handling missing channels, and managing search state in a Mattermost Redux-based application.

methods.name: getMissingChannelsFromPosts
methods.description: Fetches missing channel data for posts by dispatching getChannel, getChannelAndMyMember, and getChannelMembers for each post's channel.

methods.name: getMissingChannelsFromFiles
methods.description: Fetches missing channel data for files similarly to posts, dispatching getChannel, getChannelAndMyMember, and getChannelMembers for each file's channel.

methods.name: searchPostsWithParams
methods.description: Performs a search for posts with specified parameters, handles pagination, updates search state, and manages truncation info.

methods.name: searchPosts
methods.description: Initiates a post search with given team ID, search terms, and options, defaulting to first page.

methods.name: getMorePostsForSearch
methods.description: Loads more posts for the current search if not at the end.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears current post and file search results.

methods.name: searchFilesWithParams
methods.description: Performs a file search with specified parameters, manages pagination, and updates search state.

methods.name: getMoreFilesForSearch
methods.description: Loads more files for the current search if not at the end.

methods.name: getFlaggedPosts
methods.description: Fetches flagged posts for the current user, handling errors and updating state.

methods.name: getPinnedPosts
methods.description: Fetches pinned posts for a specified channel, handling errors and updating state.
